description: This file defines the StudentT class which provides statistical distribution functions related to Student's T distribution, including methods for calculating distribution probabilities and inverse probabilities.

classes.name: StudentT
classes.description: Provides methods for calculating Student's T distribution probabilities and their inverses.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the probability of Student's T distribution for given value, degrees of freedom, and tails.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the Student's T distribution for a given probability and degrees of freedom.

methods.name: calculateDistribution
methods.description: Private method that performs the core calculation of the Student's T distribution probability.
